scenes.onscreen_text: It has a reason for everything.
scenes.voiceover: Meet the Excuse Generator. It has a reason for everything.
scenes.visual: Victor the vampire office worker (reference character) stares deadpan at the Excuse Generator (reference character), a copper desktop contraption cranking out a long ribbon of little white excuse slips that pile onto his desk; slips read TOO BUSY and NEXT QUARTER in tiny print;

The Excuse Generator (reference character) sits half-buried in its own mountain of excuse slips, its grumpy face drooping, crank still lazily turning, one last slip drooping from its paper-slot mouth; comic futility, no menace; no computer screens visible.
